heading: Arithmetic / rounding
text:
### Arithmetic / rounding [LEXP.3.2]

| Function | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `abs(x)` | absolute value (preserves type) |
| `round(x)` | nearest integer, ties-to-even (Python banker's rounding) |
| `math.floor(x)` | largest integer ≤ x |
| `math.ceil(x)` | smallest integer ≥ x |
| `math.trunc(x)` | truncate toward zero |
| `math.sign(x)` | −1, 0, or 1, as an `Int`: 1 when `x > 0`, −1 when `x < 0`, else 0. So `-0.0` and a NaN give 0; no sign bit is read ([LEXP.4.3]) |
| `math.sqrt(x)` | √x — IEEE correctly-rounded, EXACT; NaN for a negative `x` ([LDET.3.6.2]) |
| `math.fma(x, y, z)` | $x \times y + z$, rounded once — EXACT ([LEXP.3.2.2]) |
| `math.pow(x, y)` / `x ** y`, **non-negative integer** exponent | `Int`: xʸ by repeated × — EXACT |
| `math.pow(x, y)` / `x ** y`, any other exponent | `Float`: the correctly-rounded `pow` ([LEXP.3.9.2]) — EXACT, with [LEXP.3.9.3]'s special values (`0 ** negative` is `+Inf`). Result type per [LEXP.7.3a] |

A dimensioned argument to any of these is [LUNI.8.9]'s.
